metrics.profile_summary: Creative and self-driven marketing professional with a Master's in Media Sciences. Specialized in digital marketing, social media strategy, and brand management for local and multinational brands.

experience.description: Creates client pitches for social media campaigns and develops competitive and audience analysis strategy frameworks.
Developed monthly social media calendars and strategies for local brands across dental, aesthetic, beauty, and food sectors.
Planned and optimized Facebook and Instagram ads, managed community engagement, and analyzed social data metrics.
Monitored daily campaigns, reported results to ABM, and assisted in e-commerce portal content deployment and market research.

strengths: Extensive experience in social media strategy and community management
Proven track record in reporting and competitive analysis
weaknesses: No explicit mention of TikTok experience
Canva and Excel not explicitly listed as skills
evaluation.summary: The candidate is an excellent match, exceeding the minimum experience and education requirements. They possess direct experience in almost every core responsibility of the job description, including content calendars, reporting, and community management.
